workarounds.symptom: One NaN or Inf sample in a file breaks most earshot commands
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Stop on NaN / Inf samples with one clear error (#12). Target files: earshot/audio.py, tests/test_core.py. . Float WAVs with even one NaN or Inf sample used to crash most commands. `match`, `rank` and `realness` gave wrong answers with exit 0. Now every command stops with one line and exit 1. Example with the two files from the steps in #12: - `w.wav`: 0.8 s whoosh from `earshot sfx render whoosh_fast/crisp` - `one_nan.wav`: copy of `w.wav` with its middle sample (at 0.400 s) set to NaN `rank` already skips files it can't read... (Ref: https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot/pull/13)

workarounds.symptom: Model loading clears the user's HF offline setting and downloads unpinned weights
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix #1 and #2: neutral realness guidance, pinned local-only model loading (0.2.1). Target files: earshot/__init__.py, earshot/config.py, earshot/critique.py. Three commits on `main` (9721326): one per issue (04f2d03 for #1, b90e1a1 for #2) and one review round (d1671ad) that fixes a regression from the #2 commit and a leftover of #1. Version 0.2.1, with a CHANGELOG entry for each. (Ref: https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot/pull/3)
